Timesheet.title: Timesheet
Timesheet.description: A per-employee, per-period record of worked hours submitted for approval (urenregistratie / time sheet). An employee logs hours against a period (and optionally a project/cost centre), submits the timesheet, and a manager approves or rejects it. The approval lifecycle (submitted → approved/rejected, with approver and timestamp) is the genuinely new, correctly-homed HR/labour surface that pipelinq's "Timesheet approval" deep-link previously pointed at shillinq for — shillinq's UrenRegistratie is an append-only billing time-log with no approval state, so this Timesheet schema owns the approval workflow in hrmq, the HR/labour app.

submit.description: The employee submits the timesheet for manager approval. A rejected timesheet may be corrected and re-submitted.

approve.description: A manager approves the submitted timesheet. The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-approval (the approver may not be the claiming employee); approvedBy and approvedAt are stamped on the carrying write.

reject.description: A manager rejects the submitted timesheet (with a rejectionReason). The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-rejection. The employee may correct it and re-submit.

reopen.description: Return an approved timesheet to draft for correction before it is consumed by payroll.

employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee who logged the hours (the claimant). Drives the self-approval guard — the approver may not equal this employee.

period.description: The period the timesheet covers, in YYYY-MM (or YYYY-Www for a week / YYYY-Wnn-D for a day).

hours.description: Total hours worked in the period. Reused by OpenRegister aggregations for per-employee and per-period totals.

description.description: Free-text description of the work performed.

projectId.description: Optional reference to the project the hours were worked on (for cost allocation).

costCenter.description: Optional cost centre / kostenplaats the hours are booked against.

billable.description: Whether the hours are billable to a client/project.

status.description: Approval workflow status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine.

submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the employee submitted the timesheet for approval.

approvedBy.description: User ID of the manager who approved (or rejected) the timesheet. Must differ from the claiming employee (no self-approval).

approvedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of approval or rejection.

rejectionReason.description: Reason the manager rejected the timesheet, shown to the employee so it can be corrected and re-submitted.
